related.title: OSV：鎖定檔與弱點適用性解析
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付12條路徑的人工結論、去重鍵、驗證假設、修正差異及查詢版本。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver twelve path dispositions, deduplication keys, validation assumptions, remediation diffs and query version.
related.difference: 將套件名稱、生態系、版本與修復區間分欄，追到直接或遞移依賴的根節點。
related.differenceEn: Separate ecosystem, package, version and fixed range, then trace direct or transitive dependencies to roots.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 分流工作量=候選路徑數×每條檢查分鐘；結果去重需保留不同來源或不同控制缺口。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 查詢產生18條路徑，其中6條是同一來源與輸出對的重複展示；每條人工檢查4分鐘。 需審查12條唯一候選，預估12×4=48分鐘。
受影響元件比例=符合公告範圍的唯一元件/盤點元件；公告數不等於受影響部署數。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 鎖定檔有40個唯一元件，8個落在合成公告範圍，其中3個是直接依賴、5個是遞移依賴。 受影響比例=8/40=20%；需追蹤5條遞移修復路徑。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Triage effort equals candidate paths times minutes per path; deduplication must preserve distinct sources or control gaps. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A query produces eighteen paths, six duplicate presentations of the same source-sink pair; each unique path requires four minutes. Twelve unique candidates require an estimated 12×4=48 minutes.

Affected-component fraction counts unique matching components, not advisories or deployed instances. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A lockfile contains forty unique components; eight match synthetic ranges, comprising three direct and five transitive dependencies. Affected fraction=8/40=20%; five transitive remediation paths need tracing.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Reproducible Builds：位元一致與環境邊界
related.titleEn: Reproducible Builds: byte equality and environment boundaries
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付12條路徑的人工結論、去重鍵、驗證假設、修正差異及查詢版本。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver twelve path dispositions, deduplication keys, validation assumptions, remediation diffs and query version.
related.difference: 保存來源摘要、工具鏈、語系、時區與排序規則，以二次獨立建置比對逐位元輸出。
related.differenceEn: Record source digest, toolchain, locale, timezone and ordering, then compare byte-for-byte outputs from two independent builds.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 分流工作量=候選路徑數×每條檢查分鐘；結果去重需保留不同來源或不同控制缺口。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 查詢產生18條路徑，其中6條是同一來源與輸出對的重複展示；每條人工檢查4分鐘。 需審查12條唯一候選，預估12×4=48分鐘。
一致率=摘要相同的指定產物/全部指定產物；功能測試通過與位元一致是兩種證據。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 兩次本機建置各產10個合成產物，7個摘要相同，3個含不同生成時間。 初始一致率7/10=70%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Triage effort equals candidate paths times minutes per path; deduplication must preserve distinct sources or control gaps. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A query produces eighteen paths, six duplicate presentations of the same source-sink pair; each unique path requires four minutes. Twelve unique candidates require an estimated 12×4=48 minutes.

Reproducibility rate counts matching specified artifacts; functional correctness and byte equality are different evidence. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Two local builds each produce ten synthetic artifacts; seven match and three embed different generation times. Initial reproducibility rate=7/10=70%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
